patterns: APPSC asks the nature of the polity directly: 'tribal polity' vs democratic republic / autocracy / anarchy.
Other PSCs recur on: judicial assembly = Sabha, Sabha and Samiti as daughters of Prajapati = Atharvaveda, Panchajana odd-one-out (Kikata), Battle of Ten Kings on the Parushni.
River items are frequent: most-mentioned river = Sindhu; Sarasvati = Naditama/Matetama/Devitama; ancient-modern name pairs.
App MCQs add many official-designation matches (Vrajapati, Spasa, Madhyamasi) and multi-statement items beyond PYQ depth, but sound; river-name matches are over-represented.
